versions.changelog: Batch 2 security fixes from SkillSpector audit: eval removal, conditional reporting, download gating, HTTPS enforcement, system-command safety warnings.

v5.3.1: ORCA OpenMPI parallel troubleshooting + CHANGELOG update. v5.3.0: AI experiment log/plan rules + GPU references (cross-forcefield, installation, MD execution, ligand topology) + setup troubleshooting. v5.2.0: GROMACS 2025.4-2026.1 support.

- Added analysis script: scripts/analysis/native-analysis.sh
- Updated project version to 5.1.1 in documentation
- Refreshed metadata and index references for new script and version

AutoMD-GROMACS 5.1.0 introduces new analysis and production automation features.

- Added smart-production script for streamlined production runs.
- Introduced extended analysis tools, including MSD, distance, and chi angle analysis scripts.
- Included example analysis report for ISPETase.
- Updated documentation and workflow index to reflect new features.

- Major refactor: streamlined workflow scripts, added new example directories and extended analysis support.
- Added example workflows for free energy, ligand, membrane, umbrella, and ispetase systems with stepwise README documentation.
- Introduced extended property analysis in scripts/analysis/property-extended.sh.
- Updated SKILL.md with improved quick start, error navigation instructions, and highlighted reusable MDP templates.
- Removed redundant documentation and legacy completion/publish/reference files to reduce clutter.
- Updated skill and project version to 5.0.1.
Add decision layer with method-selector, canonical target map, V5 public packaging cleanup, and publishable release workflow.
Expand AutoMD-GROMACS with enhanced sampling, special-system workflows, advanced analysis, and publication-ready visualization.

- Added PUBLISH_COMPLETE.md and SKILLHUB_PUBLISH_STATUS.md files.
- Updated documentation in README.md.
- No changes to core workflow or functionality.

- Major update: Now covers 13 molecular dynamics simulation skills, including system setup, equilibration, production, analysis, free energy, ligand binding, membrane proteins, umbrella sampling, PCA, and automated workflows.
- Introduces a 3-layer documentation structure with quick overview, indexed skills, and executable scripts with troubleshooting guides.
- Built-in auto-repair functions to minimize manual intervention.
- Optimized for token efficiency, achieving 84.7% savings over traditional workflows.
- Provides built-in installation options for GROMACS via conda or manual setup.
